The evidence explicitly defines the calculation of `x_d` in the `VoxelGrid.density` method. It calculates `x_0` as `int(x)` (the integer part of x) and `x_1` as `x_0 + 1`. It then defines `x_d = (x - x_0) / (x_1 - x_0)`. If `x` is an integer, then `int(x)` equals `x`, so `x_0 = x`. Consequently, the numerator `(x - x_0)` becomes `(x - x) = 0`. The denominator `(x_1 - x_0)` becomes `(x + 1 - x) = 1`. Therefore, `x_d = 0 / 1 = 0`. This holds true for all cases where `x` is an integer, as confirmed by the logic in the source code provided in S1.
